jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description: **About CroJack** CroJack is a privately held group operating across North America and as of 2026 Europe. The group is a private, relationship\-driven inventory solutions company connecting leading consumer brands with a curated network of vetted buyers worldwide. We currently operate four active entities across Canada and the U.S., Barbados, with a UK entity and a Malta entity coming online. Books are maintained in Canadian and U.S. dollars, consolidated in USD, with GBP and EUR reporting added as the European structure goes live. The business is intercompany\-heavy by design: capital and trade flows move between entities continuously. The group operates in English across every jurisdiction, including with its overseas partners. This is a build role, not a maintenance role. The accounting function is being professionalized at the same time the group is expanding internationally, and the Controller is the person who owns that build. **The Role** The Controller owns the accounting close, the consolidation, and the integrity of the numbers across every entity in the group. You will be the senior accounting authority in\-house, reporting to the CEO. The work sits at the intersection of three things that rarely show up together: **modern finance technology, multientity and multi\-currency consolidation and treasury, and physical cross\-border trade.** If you have done all three, this role is built for you. **The Path** This is a succession plan, not a job posting with a growth paragraph attached. CroJack runs its CFO function fractionally today, and that has been the right structure for a company this size. It will not be the right structure forever. As the European entities come online, the reporting layer matures, and the group's financial operations consolidate onto a single platform, CroJack will need a full\-time CFO in\-house. The intent is that it is you. The fractional CFO is not protecting that seat. The engagement is deliberately structured to transfer it — scope handed over in a planned sequence, with the parts you have not done yet taught rather than withheld. That is what a fractional CFO is for at this stage of a company's life: build the function, build the person who runs it, and step out. We are not naming a date, because the date depends on how fast the group grows and how fast you take the work. We are telling you the seat is the destination and the handoff is the plan. If you are a Controller who has outgrown a maintenance seat and wants the exposure that actually builds a CFO — capital, lenders, structure, and commercial judgment, not just a clean close — this is that seat. **How the Handoff Works** **• Phase one — you own the engine.** Close, consolidation, intercompany, compliance, and the systems build are yours. The fractional CFO holds treasury strategy, the lender relationship, and structuring work — and you are in every one of those conversations from day one. **• Phase two — you take the external seat.** Lender relationship, ownership and board\-level reporting, capital and working capital decisions, and commercial input transfer to you. The fractional CFO moves to advisory. **• Phase three — you hold the scope.** You are CroJack's CFO. The fractional engagement winds down to project support, or ends. Each phase carries a corresponding step in compensation and title. The scope moves first; the recognition follows it, and it is not left to be renegotiated from scratch. **What This Seat Gives You** * Direct ownership of the lender relationship and the credit facility — you build the reporting, you sit in the conversations * Ownership\-level reporting: you present the numbers and answer for them, rather than handing a package upward * Entity formation and cross\-border structuring as the UK, Malta, and Barbados entities come online, including the transfer pricing and compliance architecture that goes with them * Working capital and capital allocation decisions — deal funding, counterparty terms, and prepayment exposure are real capital decisions in this business * Commercial input: margin by deal, channel, and counterparty, and pricing conversations informed by true landed cost * Full ownership of the financial tech stack business case — build it, defend it to ownership, and own the outcome * A fractional CFO whose explicit mandate is to hand you the role — direct mentorship, with scope transferred in a planned sequence rather than absorbed by accident **What You'll Own** **Close, Consolidation, and Reporting** * Own the monthly close across all group entities — Canadian, U.S., Barbados, and European — and deliver a consolidated reporting package on a predictable calendar * Produce consolidated financial statements in USD, with currency translation performed against a published, internationally recognized rate source and a documented, defensible FX policy * Prepare entity\-level and consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow, with variance commentary the CEO can act on * Build and transferred. You are CroJack's CFO, and the fractional engagement has done what it was built to do **What We're Looking For** **Required** * CPA designation (Ordre des CPA du Québec, or CPA Canada with Quebec recognition), or an equivalent international designation recognized in Quebec * 7\+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3\+ years at a Controller or Assistant Controller level * Demonstrated multi\-entity consolidation experience — you have personally owned a consolidation, not just contributed schedules to one * Multi\-currency accounting experience, including translation methodology, FX gain/loss treatment, and consolidating entities with different functional currencies * International trade or import/export accounting experience — landed cost, duty and tariff treatment, customs documentation, incoterms, and inventory costing on imported goods * Intercompany accounting experience across jurisdictions: loans, allocations, settlements, and eliminations * Canadian compliance fluency: GST/HST and QST filing, CRA and Revenu Québec correspondence, and preparing clean, tie\-out\-ready support for external tax advisors * Systems\-forward — you have personally selected, implemented, or rebuilt a finance tech stack, and can point to close time or headcount you took out of the process, not just software you bought * Advanced Excel — you build models, not just fill in templates * The judgment and directness to tell ownership when a number is wrong, and the documentation to back it up **Strongly Preferred** * Consumer products, toy, apparel, CPG, or another physical\-goods importing business * Cross\-border U.S./Canada accounting, including U.S. state filing exposure * UK or EU experience — VAT, statutory filing requirements, or entity setup * ERP implementation experience, particularly a migration from small\-business accounting software to a true multi\-entity platform * Licensing or royalty accounting * Experience in an owner\-operated or founder\-led company, where the Controller is expected to solve problems rather than escalate them * Transfer pricing exposure **How You Work** * You are comfortable being the most senior accounting person in the room and the one who is accountable when the numbers are questioned * You would rather build the process once, properly, than patch it every month * You can move between a customs invoice, an intercompany loan schedule, and a conversation with the CEO about cash without losing the thread * You are direct, and you do not soften a material issue to keep a meeting comfortable * You want the CFO seat and can articulate specifically what you still need to learn to hold it — self\-awareness about the gap matters more to us than a polished claim that there isn't one * You can learn from someone whose job is to make themselves unnecessary to you, and you will ask for the handoff rather than wait to be offered it * You are comfortable in a growing, owner\-operated business where the scope expands faster than the org chart does **Compensation** * Base salary: CAD $110,000 to $130,000 commensurate with experience * Compensation reviewed at each phase of the handoff — the step in scope carries a step in pay and title, agreed in principle at hire rather than renegotiated later * Performance bonus tied to close quality, compliance calendar integrity, and tech implementation milestones * Fully remote, based in Montreal **To Apply** Send a resume and a short note covering three things: the most complex consolidation you have personally owned, a specific example of an international trade or landed cost issue you identified and fixed, and the part of the CFO role you feel least ready for today. Applications to holly@crojack.com We review on a rolling basis. CroJack is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and provide accommodation on request throughout the recruitment process. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Founding AI Research Lead - Agentic AI Lab
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **Founding AI Research Lead \- Agentic AI Lab** *San Francisco Bay Area \| Full time* Backed by 8VC, we are building a world\-class team to tackle one of industry's most critical problems: trusted AI for enterprise operations. **About the Role** Fabrion is designing the future of enterprise AI infrastructure, grounded in agents, knowledge graphs, and multi\-tenant governance. We are working on research inside the Agentic AI Lab to train and evaluate specialized models for mission\-critical enterprise work. The direction is specific and ambitious. We share the full thesis under NDA during the interview process. What we can say here: the program has committed design partners with production data access, dedicated compute, a benchmark\-first plan with clear go and no\-go gates, and a platform team that has already built the governance and serving layer your models will run behind. This is full\-cycle research: problem formulation, data, training, evaluation, and deployment, with your name on the results. **Core Responsibilities** * Own the research agenda: model and training design, evaluation protocol, and the publication plan * Take models from public benchmark results to live customer shadow deployments, with gates you define and defend * Set the benchmark discipline: strong baselines first, published comparables cited, results that survive scrutiny * Lead and grow a small team (ML engineer, data engineer, contractors) and pair closely with the founders and platform team * Write technical plans internally and papers externally when results warrant it **Desired Experience** * Hands\-on experience training sequence models, owning the tokenizer, the training loop, and the evaluation, not only fine\-tuning through APIs * Strong background in at least two of: reinforcement learning (especially offline and imitation settings), sequence decision modeling, structured or constrained generation, learning from event and log data * A track record of shipping research into a product or landing a rigorous benchmark result * PhD in machine learning or a closely related field, or an equivalent research record * Preferred Tech Stack * PyTorch, the Hugging Face ecosystem, experiment tracking and reproducible training pipelines, modern cloud data warehouses, evaluation harness engineering **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * Comfortable as the most senior researcher in the room: setting direction under ambiguity and writing decisions down * Rigor over hype: you distrust your own results until the baselines agree * A teacher's instinct: part of this role is turning strong engineers into researchers **Why This Role Matters** We believe specialized models built on governed enterprise data can run real, multi\-billion\-dollar workflows. Your work will not be buried in research reports. It will be benchmarked in public, deployed to real customers, and activated by hundreds of thousands of decisions.

Work Directly With Founders You will work closely with the CEO, Co\-Founders, and founding engineering team without layers of middle management. Build From the Ground Up You'll have the opportunity to architect and build core infrastructure rather than simply maintaining an existing system. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (TPM)
jobs.description: POSITION OVERVIEW We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive large\-scale technology initiatives from planning through launch and ongoing support. This role requires a strong technical background in software systems, architecture, cloud platforms, and APIs, paired with deep experience managing cross\-functional project teams, risks, and timelines. You will bridge the gap between engineering teams and executive leadership, keeping delivery predictable, secure, and aligned with core business goals. WHAT YOU WILL DO * Program Ownership: Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex software and systems initiatives, building detailed roadmaps, schedules, and success metrics. * Dependency \& Risk Management: Identify delivery bottlenecks, track cross\-team technical dependencies, and resolve risks before they impact timelines. * Architecture \& Technical Alignment: Work with software engineers and architects to evaluate system designs, APIs, data flows, cloud setups, and technical trade\-offs regarding scalability, performance, and security. * Governance \& Reporting: Establish meeting rhythms, program health metrics, and clear updates covering schedules, blockers, and decisions. * Executive Communication: Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and status reports for senior leaders. * Continuous Improvement: Streamline execution processes, promote agile best practices, and mentor junior or peer project leads. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Experience * 8\+ years in software engineering, systems engineering, system architecture, or technical program management (10\+ years preferred). * Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-level technology applications from concept to production launch. * Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project environments. Technical Competencies * Deep understanding of software development principles, distributed architecture, RESTful APIs, cloud services, and data management. * Ability to read, interpret, and evaluate software architecture and code (no hands\-on coding required). * Strong grasp of platform scalability, system reliability, data flows, and enterprise security standards. Leadership \& Soft Skills * Clear written and verbal communication skills across both technical teams and executive management. * Ability to bring clarity, structure, and accountability to high\-ambiguity project environments. * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on data\-driven decision\-making. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Technical background as a former Software Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Solutions Architect. * Experience setting up formal program governance, delivery KPIs, and operational metrics across multiple engineering teams. * Background mentoring team members or coaching technical leads on program delivery discipline. jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Confident working with APIs, integrations and webhooks; * Comfortable with production engineering topics including authentication, scopes, secrets management, logging, monitoring, cost control and API limitations; * Enough infrastructure knowledge to independently deploy and maintain the solutions you build; * Able to demonstrate 2–3 AI agents you have built and deployed with measurable business outcomes such as hours saved, reduced error rates, improved cycle times or revenue impact; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. We want you shaping the playbook, not just following it.

jobs.title: Head of Insights & Analytics – North America
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. The Head of Insights \& Analytics – North America will lead the delivery of insights, analytics and AI solutions that support North American underwriting teams in making better, faster and more informed decisions. This role is accountable for translating business priorities into impactful data products, analytics solutions and AI\-enabled capabilities that improve underwriting performance, portfolio management, risk selection, operational efficiency and customer outcomes. You will also play a critical leadership role in delivering AI\-enabled underwriting transformation initiatives, including oversight of the AI components of AXCEED and other key initiatives within the North American strategic portfolio. You will serve as the primary interface between North American business stakeholders and the broader Data \& Analytics organization, ensuring that priorities are aligned, solutions are fit\-for\-purpose, and value is realized. What will you do in this role? **Lead North America Insights \& Analytics Delivery** * Own the delivery and value realization of the North America Insights \& Analytics portfolio. * Act as the primary Data \& Analytics partner to North American underwriting leadership teams. * Develop a deep understanding of underwriting strategy, operational challenges and growth objectives. * Translate business opportunities into actionable analytics, AI and data product initiatives. **Deliver Measurable Business Value** * Ensure all initiatives are linked to clear business outcomes and success measures. * Drive adoption of analytics and AI solutions across underwriting teams. * Champion evidence\-based decision making through effective use of data and insights. **Lead AI and Advanced Analytics Solutions** * Provide business leadership and oversight for AI\-enabled underwriting initiatives. * Partner with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology teams to industrialize and scale AI capabilities. * Ensure AI solutions are aligned to AXIS governance standards, risk appetite and responsible AI principles. * Promote practical and value\-focused use of AI across the North America underwriting function. **Build Strong Business Partnerships** * Establish trusted relationships with North America underwriting leaders and key stakeholders. * Act as a trusted advisor on insights, analytics, AI and data\-driven decision making. * Facilitate alignment between business priorities and enterprise Data \& Analytics strategy. **Lead and Develop High Performing Teams** * Provide leadership to North America\-aligned Insights \& Analytics team members. * Create an environment that promotes collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement and accountability. * Develop team capability across insights, analytics and AI disciplines. * Foster knowledge sharing and reuse across the wider Insights \& Analytics community. **Improve Ways of Working** * Drive adoption of agile and product\-oriented delivery practices. * Ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable and maintainable. * Promote reuse of data products, models and analytics capabilities. * Foster a culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement. *Success Measures* Success in this role will be measured through: **Business Impact** * Demonstrable improvement in underwriting effectiveness, portfolio performance and operational efficiency resulting from delivered solutions. * Quantifiable business value generated through insights, analytics and AI initiatives. **Stakeholder Satisfaction** * Strong business partner satisfaction and trust. * Insights and analytics capabilities becoming embedded within day\-to\-day underwriting decision making. **Portfolio Delivery** * Successful execution of North America strategic portfolio commitments. * Delivery of agreed outcomes, benefits and value targets. **Team Performance** * High levels of engagement, capability development and retention. * Strong collaboration across the wider Data \& Analytics function. **Innovation and Modernization** * Increased adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities. * Improved speed, quality and scalability of insights and analytics delivery. About you: We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals. *What**you need to have:* **Experience** * Significant experience leading analytics, business intelligence, data science or AI teams within complex organizations. * Experience partnering closely with insurance underwriting or specialty insurance business functions. * Demonstrated success delivering business value through analytics and AI initiatives. * Experience leading cross\-functional transformation or strategic delivery programs. * Proven record of influencing senior stakeholders and executive leadership teams. * Experience operating within agile delivery environments. **Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** * Strong understanding of insights, analytics, data science, AI and data product delivery. * Knowledge of modern AI and machine learning capabilities, including generative AI applications. * Understanding of underwriting processes, portfolio management and insurance analytics. * Strong appreciation of responsible AI, governance and risk management principles. * Ability to identify the most appropriate solution for a business problem, whether traditional reporting, advanced analytics, predictive modelling or AI. **Leadership Capabilities** * Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen. * Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. * Strong people leadership and coaching capability. * Ability to bring clarity and direction in complex environments. * Comfortable balancing strategic priorities with delivery execution. *What we prefer you to have:* Education: An advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or similar) is highly desirable, or equivalent professional experience. In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. jobs.title: Palantir Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **We Are** **The Accenture Palantir Business Group (APBG)** is a global business group within Accenture that combines Accenture’s industry, data, and AI expertise with Palantir’s Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) to help organizations scale AI and transform decision‑making. Formed in 2025 as part of Accenture’s expanded strategic partnership with Palantir, APBG serves as a center of excellence delivering Palantir‑enabled solutions across industries such as government, healthcare, energy, financial services, and manufacturing. The group accelerates enterprise reinvention by integrating consulting, engineering, and global delivery capabilities to move clients from siloed data to integrated, AI‑driven decision intelligence. **You Are:** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be responsible for helping our clients solve their most pressing challenges, from the battlefield to supply chains, benefits programs, and broader government operations. You will work as part of a small team of engineers, domain experts, and other Deployment Strategists to turn a client’s vision into reality by deploying Palantir software and building tailored solutions that make a measurable impact on their operations. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Work with cross\-functional teams**: Partner with engineers, program managers, and domain specialists to design, build, and support client\-facing applications. * **Translate objectives into a delivery plan**: Gather requirements, analyze data and workflows, and define a roadmap from prototype to scaled deployment. * **Prototype and iterate quickly**: Build from scratch when needed, validate with users, and iterate rapidly based on feedback and operational results. * **Deliver production\-grade solutions**: Ship reliable pipelines and applications that turn client data into operational workflows and decision support. * **Align and communicate**: Write clear requirements, share progress with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and drive work to release. **What We Look For:** --------------------- * **Client success mindset**: Own the outcome, go beyond the stated scope when needed, and consistently deliver value for the customer. * **Structured problem solving**: Break down ambiguous problems, identify constraints, and design end\-to\-end solutions. * **Software \+ data engineering fundamentals**: Write production code (e.g., Python, TypeScript) and build applications on large structured and unstructured datasets. * **Bias for ownership**: Work independently, drive decisions, and be accountable for results. * **Track record of delivery**: Ship software/analytics that produces measurable, real\-world outcomes. * **Collaboration and client\-facing communication**: Work effectively with teammates and clients across technical levels; embed with customer teams when required. jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **Job Summary** We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and event\-driven architectures to build and support scalable, cloud\-native applications. This role will focus on developing microservices, real\-time data streaming solutions, and modern web applications while leveraging technologies such as Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, React/Angular, and cloud\-native platforms. The ideal candidate has experience designing distributed systems, building high\-performance backend services, and collaborating across engineering, platform, and DevOps teams to deliver resilient, production\-ready solutions. **This role is based out of our corporate headquarters in Raleigh, NC. This is a hybrid work model (4 days in office, 1 day remote).** **Backend \& Microservices Engineering** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and microservices using Java, Spring jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer- AI/ML, AWS Neuron
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Shape the Future of AI Accelerators at AWS Neuron We build Amazon Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Machine Learning Applications team, you will optimize the world's most demanding AI models at a scale few engineers ever get to work on. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high\-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology. You can learn more about Neuron https://awsdocs\-neuron.readthedocs\-hosted.com https://aws.amazon.com/machine\-learning/neuron/ https://github.com/aws/aws\-neuron\-sdk https://www.amazon.science/how\-silicon\-innovation\-became\-the\-secret\-sauce\-behind\-awss\-success Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities This role will help lead the efforts in building distributed inference support for Pytorch in the Neuron SDK. This role will tune these models to ensure highest performance and maximize the efficiency of them running on the customer AWS Trainium and Inferentia silicon and servers. Strong software development using Python, System level programming and ML knowledge are both critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low\-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will: * Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models including GPT, Kimi, and Qwen on custom AI accelerators. * Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle including distributed computing based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, low level optimizations, and production deployment. * Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architecture. * Design and implement high\-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models * Analyze and optimize system\-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware * Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks * Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling * Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators * Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques * Develop kernels to improve model efficiency on Amazon AI Accelerators * Transform complex tensor operations into highly optimized graph implementations * Optimize state\-of\-the\-art language, vision, and multimodal generative AI models for Neuron hardware What Makes This Role Unique: * Direct influence on AWS's AI Accelerator used by thousands of ML applications * Full\-stack optimization from high\-level frameworks to low level primitives * Collaboration with both open\-source ML communities and hardware architecture teams * Requires passion for performance tuning and system architecture A day in the life You will collaborate with a cross\-functional team of applied scientists, system engineers, and product managers to deliver state\-of\-the\-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and shaping the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You will also build high\-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross\-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup\-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important initiative. Work/Life Balance Our team puts a high value on work\-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and fulfillment. About the team At AWS Neuron, we're revolutionizing how the world's most sophisticated AI models run at scale through Amazon's next\-generation AI accelerators. The Inference Enablement and Acceleration team is at the forefront of running a wide range of models and supporting novel architecture alongside maximizing their performance for Amazon's custom ML accelerators. Working across the stack from PyTorch till the hardware\-software boundary, our engineers build systematic software stack, innovate new methods and create high\-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. The team collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * Knowledge of Python and/or C\+\+ programming * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems * Knowledge of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles * Experience owning a performance optimization roadmap and mentoring engineers on optimization **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Master's degree in computer science or equivalent * Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference * Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques * Hands\-on development with PyTorch is preferred * Experience scaling workloads across multi\-GPU and multi\-node topologies with NCCL and tensor, pipeline, or expert parallelism * Experience writing and optimizing custom CUDA/Triton kernels for tensor operations Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, WA, Seattle \- 168,100\.00 \- 227,400\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises. The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed. The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us! About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of technical engineering experience * Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment * Bachelor's degree **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings * Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. The Sub\-Same\-Day (SSD) team builds the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery promises across India and Emerging Marketplaces — getting orders to customers in hours, not days. We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II who wants to own high\-scale, low\-latency systems that directly move the speed and reliability customers see at checkout. You'll design and build services that compute and optimize the fastest reliable delivery promise for every order. * Build customer\-facing systems at massive scale and single\-digit\-millisecond latency * Own features end\-to\-end, from design through production and operations * Directly impact conversion, delivery speed, and customer trust across 10\+ marketplaces Key job responsibilities * Design, build, and operate scalable, low\-latency, highly available services that power SSD delivery promises. * Own features end\-to\-end — requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations. * Lead design discussions and independently drive alignment with partner teams (Promise, transportation, search etc. ). * Uphold operational excellence: monitoring, alarming, on\-call, and driving down defects and tickets. * Dive deep on edge cases, testing, and safe production rollouts (canary deployments, metrics, dashboards). * Proactively identify and mitigate risks; communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly. * Mentor SDE\-1s and junior engineers — review code and designs, unblock them, and raise the technical bar. * Contribute to the team's technical roadmap and continuous improvement of our systems. A day in the life You'll partner with product managers, applied scientists, and engineering teams across Promise, ATROPS, transportation, and DEX to ship features that make delivery faster and more reliable. A typical day includes a team standup, design and code reviews, hands\-on development, and digging into production metrics. You'll take part in operational excellence and on\-call to keep our services healthy. Beyond delivery, we invest in learning and fun — quarterly hackathons and fortnightly GenAI brown\-bag sessions where the team explores new technology together. About the team The Sub\-Same\-Day (SSD) team owns the technology behind Amazon's fastest delivery experiences across India and Emerging Marketplaces (AU, BR, MX, AE, SA, SG, EG, TR, ZA). Our mission is to give every customer the fastest reliable promise we can keep — and to extend same\-day and sub\-same\-day speed to new marketplaces and customers. We're a high\-ownership, customer\-obsessed team that values deep technical work, operational excellence, and continuous learning. jobs.title: 3D Product Configurator & Commerce Integration
jobs.description: **Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration** Drive Commerce / WebGL, integrated with SAP S/4HANA, Centric PLM and PIM/MDM **About Us** Atlas Systems Inc. is a software solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas delivers solutions across GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare and ERP for customers worldwide, combining more than two decades of software experience with global reach and deep expertise across multiple industry verticals. This role sits within our enterprise retail practice, supporting a premium consumer\-products brand’s direct\-to\-consumer personalization program — where customers configure personalized products (imprinting, embroidery, laser engraving, monogramming, and color / material options) through interactive 3D experiences that must flow cleanly into an SAP S/4HANA\-based commerce and manufacturing backbone. To apply: https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/617 **Role Snapshot** **Job Title** Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration **Location** United States (remote, with periodic on\-site at the client site as required) **Work Model** Hybrid / Remote **Experience** 8\+ years **Employment Type** Full\-time **Position Summary** We are seeking a Senior Engineer to own the technical implementation, architecture and support of interactive 3D product\-configuration experiences — and, critically, their integration into the enterprise product\-data and order ecosystem. This is not a rendering\-only role. Success depends equally on a high\-fidelity 3D front end and on translating each customer configuration into a correct, orderable SKU, Bill of Materials and price within SAP S/4HANA. You will be the primary engineering owner for the configurator platform (Drive Commerce / WebGL) and its connections to the commerce platform (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), product lifecycle management (Centric PLM), the PIM / MDM layer (Precisely EnterWorks), integration middleware (webMethods), and downstream order management and fulfillment (Manhattan / WMS). In short: you make sure that what the customer configures on screen is exactly what gets priced, ordered, manufactured and shipped. **Key Responsibilities** **3D Configurator Engineering** * **Configurator ownership —** Own end\-to\-end development of interactive 3D web configurators built on the Drive Commerce plugin\-based JavaScript / WebGL framework (Three.js and / or Babylon.js). * **Performance —** Deliver responsive, performant experiences across mobile and desktop against defined performance budgets for load time, frame rate and memory. * **Stability —** Diagnose and resolve rendering, texture and canvas issues, including browser memory leaks and WebGL context loss. * **Technical leadership —** Lead architecture, code review and feature delivery for real\-time product personalization. **Configuration\-to\-Order Integration (core to this role)** * **Recipe** **SAP —** Design and maintain the mapping from a customer’s 3D “recipe” to a valid, orderable outcome in SAP S/4HANA — resolving each configuration to the correct material / SKU, Bill of Materials and price, using SAP variant configuration / configurable materials and made\-to\-order flows as applicable. * **Master\-data sync —** Keep the configurator’s variant / option matrix in sync with master data governed in Centric PLM and Precisely EnterWorks, so options, prices and availability stay accurate. * **End\-to\-end flow —** Build and maintain integrations across the commerce platform, middleware (webMethods / APIs), OMS and fulfillment (Manhattan), delivering accurate build sheets, pick lists and BOMs to manufacturing. * **Availability logic —** Implement made\-to\-order availability and lead\-time logic in the configuration experience (finished\-product availability and lead times, not raw\-material inventory). **Data, Pricing \& Accuracy** * **Data contracts —** Establish stable data contracts (JSON payloads, catalog indexes, option and price models) between the front end and back\-end systems. * **Accuracy —** Ensure price and SKU accuracy end to end, so the configured price and product match what is ordered, invoiced and manufactured. * **Color fidelity —** Implement ICC\-based color management so on\-screen color matches the manufactured product across materials, thread, print and engraving. * **Moderation —** Implement personalization safeguards — profanity and trademark / brand moderation on custom text and uploaded logos. **Asset \& Pipeline Collaboration** * **Asset workflows —** Partner with 3D design / asset teams (internal or agency) to translate high\-fidelity CAD / mesh assets into optimized web assets, communicating payload, texture and performance constraints. Deep 3D artistry and shader authoring are a plus, not the primary function of this role. * **Versioning —** Maintain versioned asset and configuration pipelines with clear release control. **Quality, Performance \& Support** * **Metrics e production support for the configurator and its integrations. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant e\-commerce storefront and / or product\-configurator development. * Hands\-on experience with web\-based 3D graphics — WebGL with Three.js and / or Babylon.js — including performance optimization and browser memory management. * Demonstrated experience integrating a storefront or configurator with enterprise back\-end systems — ERP (ideally SAP), PLM and / or PIM / MDM — covering product master data, pricing and BOM / order flows. This is the key differentiator for the role. * Strong JavaScript / TypeScript and modern front\-end framework experience (React or Next.js; Vue acceptable), REST / GraphQL API design and state management. * Experience delivering complex visual and commerce software within cross\-functional agile teams. **Preferred / Strongly Desired** * Drive Commerce Customizer / 3D Configurator Platform and Drive Recipe API, or a comparable configurator platform. * Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA / OCAPI / cartridges), or an equivalent enterprise commerce platform. * SAP integration experience — variant configuration / configurable materials, material master, pricing and BOM; integration middleware such as web Methods. * Centric PLM and / or Precisely Enter Works, or comparable PLM / PIM / MDM platforms. * Manhattan or comparable WMS / order\-fulfillment integration. * ICC color management and personalization / customization commerce experience (imprint, embroidery, engraving, monogramming). **Technical Skills** * **Front\-end \& 3D:** JavaScript / TypeScript, WebGL, Three.js / Babylon.js, React / Next.js, shaders and materials (working knowledge), responsive UX, browser performance profiling. * **Integration \& data:** REST / GraphQL APIs, JSON / XML transforms, event and middleware patterns (webMethods or similar), product\-data and SKU / variant modeling, pricing models. * **Commerce \& ERP:** SFCC (or equivalent), SAP product and order concepts (variant configuration, material master, BOM, pricing), OMS / WMS order flows. * **Tooling:** Git / GitHub, Jira, CI / CD (Azure DevOps or similar), Webpack / Vite, Postman; AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot). **Preferred Certifications** * Salesforce Certified B2C Commerce Developer. * Relevant 3D / WebGL or cloud developer certifications (e.g., AWS or Azure Associate). * Certified Scrum Master (CSM). **Success Measures (first 6–12 months)** * **Performance —** The configurator meets performance targets — Largest Contentful Paint and Core Web Vitals within target on mid\-tier mobile, and a stable target frame rate under full option load. * **Configuration\-to\-order accuracy —** A defined, high percentage of configurations resolve to the correct SAP material / SKU, BOM and price with no manual correction. * **Price accuracy —** The configured price matches the ordered and invoiced price. * **Reliability —** Low configurator error and defect rates in production, and high uptime for the configurator and its integrations. * **Fidelity \& safeguards —** On\-screen color matches manufactured output within agreed tolerance, and personalization moderation prevents disallowed content. * **Scalability —** Reusable components and clear documentation reduce time\-to\-launch for new configurable products. **Core Competencies** * Bridges front\-end 3D engineering and enterprise commerce / ERP integration. * Strong systems thinking across product data, pricing and order flows. * Performance and memory debugging in the browser. * Clear communication with creative, commerce and ERP / data teams. * Ownership of and accountability for accuracy from configuration to manufactured product. * Rapidly learns and integrates new interactive and integration technologies.

jobs.title: Industrial Recycling Systems Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: **Step into a day on our Field Service team** --------------------------------------------- Sun up in Fort Worth. You load the truck, review the work orders, and head to a regional distribution center to bring a downed baler back online. By mid\-morning, you're tracing a hydraulic issue, verifying 480V feeds, and dialing in a VFD. After lunch, you upgrade a conveyor safety circuit and validate PLC I/O. Before heading out, you walk the customer through what you fixed and what's next. Tomorrow could be a manufacturing plant, a material processing center, or a recycling facility—anywhere across the U.S., with occasional international travel. You'll be joining a 30\-year industry leader in waste and recycling equipment—an organization trusted by distribution centers, manufacturing plants, material processors, and recycling operations nationwide and abroad. jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 09/05/2026Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received. Meet the Team Cisco Meraki's Wireless team develops and maintains the world's leading cloud\-managed WLAN Access Point ecosystem, serving millions of active devices across the globe. Our mission is to simplify technology so customers can focus on what matters most—their students, patients, customers, and businesses. The MR firmware team is a collaborative group of highly experienced software engineers with diverse technical backgrounds, working on everything from leading\-edge wireless protocols to architectural innovations and customer\-impacting optimizations. We're passionate about delivering wireless solutions that simply work, and we're excited to tackle the next generation of performance and capability challenges in 802\.11 standards and beyond. Your Impact As a Lead Firmware Engineer on the Wireless Performance team, you will drive the evaluation and optimization of performance on MR Access Point devices, directly impacting millions of customers worldwide. Solve functional and performance\-related regressions in our Access Point firmware while actively developing features aligned with emerging 802\.11 and networking standards, ensuring we maintain both innovation and legacy compatibility. Design and implement next\-level data plane optimizations by evaluating existing components, identifying performance bottlenecks, and collaborating across teams to deliver novel solutions. Develop comprehensive tests and processes to proactively triage and resolve performance and functional issues, working with the team to establish processes that elevate product quality. Lead small\-to\-medium features from technical design through completion, advocating for customer\-centric improvements and articulating design choices grounded in market awareness and competitive positioning. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field with 8\+ years of total software engineering experience or Master's with 6\+ years of total software engineering experience * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience in production environments using C or C\+\+ programming * Prior experience with Wi\-Fi drivers and firmware, including direct collaboration with Wi\-Fi vendors to triage, open, and resolve technical issues * Experience working in Linux and/or embedded systems environments with knowledge of TCP/IP and UDP protocols * Applied experience with 802\.11 wireless standards and core network protocols (DNS, DHCP, VLANs), including analyzing Wireshark packet captures for debugging and root cause analysis Preferred Qualifications * Deep understanding of system performance optimizations including system/traffic profiling and performance\-oriented data structure and algorithm development * Hands\-on experience with performance testing tools such as iperf, Ixia Traffic Generators (Ixia Chariot, iGen), and equivalent platforms * Experience with hardware and software acceleration paradigms including DPDK, VPP, multi\-threading, or similar technologies * Proficiency with Yocto build systems and embedded Linux development * AI\-first development mindset with demonstrated experience using modern AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or Codex Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: Quality Engineer (AI Automation)
jobs.description: About Cognizant’s Quality Engineering \& Assurance Team Our Quality Engineering \& Assurance team is the innovative engine at our company. We are a dedicated group of builders and problem\-solvers responsible for the most critical, customer\-facing platforms. Within this team, the Quality practice is not a downstream function but a fully integrated partner in development. Our mission is to embed quality into every stage of the lifecycle, and as a Quality Engineer, you will be on the front lines of this effort. Position Overview Are you a driven Quality Engineer passionate about building the future of testing? We are seeking a creative and hands\-on QE to be a key contributor to our quality practice. This is an exciting opportunity to move beyond traditional QA and dive into the world of AI\-driven testing, helping us build and maintain robust quality standards for our mission\-critical intelligent applications that are redefining customer interaction. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain test automation frameworks using Java and Python. Write clean, efficient, and scalable automation scripts for new features to ensure robust test coverage across all deliverables. **Perform API testing:** Understand API concepts, develop and execute functional tests, interpret Swagger YAML files, and validate endpoints using Postman or Rest Assured automation frameworks. **Conduct database testing:** Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve, update, and delete data, ensuring database integrity and reliability. **Own quality for assigned features and components:** Collaborate with product managers and developers on requirements analysis, create detailed test cases, execute comprehensive test suites (functional, integration, regression), and provide final quality sign\-off. **Track and report testing progress:** Use tools such as JIRA, ADO, or ALM for defect logging and reporting, ensuring transparency of feature quality to the team and stakeholders. Also understanding of CI/CD concepts. **Implement and execute test plans for AI/ML applications:** Support QA activities and certify the quality of AI\-powered systems, including hands\-on testing of chatbots for intent recognition, conversational flow, response accuracy, and edge case handling. **Leverage modern AI tools to enhance workflow:** Utilize AI code assistants like GitHub Copilot to accelerate test script development and explore generative AI for tasks such as test data creation and bug report summarization. **Ensure AI reliability and fairness:** Execute test cases to identify issues related to bias, fairness, and model robustness, contributing to the overall trustworthiness of AI systems. Develop and maintain test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python. Have proficiency with test and defect management tools, particularly JIRA or any similar tools. Required Skills \& Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 0 – 1 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering role. Some hands\-on experience developing and maintaining test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python. Basic understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and practical experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. A keen interest in or prior experience testing AI\-powered applications, such as chatbots or other AI/ML\-based systems. Hands\-on experience with the Hybrid Automation frameworks. Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions). Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling). Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker) A passion for learning and staying up to date with the latest trends in AI and software testing. Location New hires will be hired to the Cognizant office in Dallas/Plano TX, Charlotte/Cary NC, Teaneck NJ, Miami FL where you will work alongside other experienced Cognizant associates delivering technology solutions. Applicants must be willing to relocate to this major geographic area. While we attempt to honor candidate location preferences, business needs and position availability will determine final location assignment. Start Date New hires will start in September 2026 . While we will attempt to honor candidate start date preferences, business need and position availability will determine final start date assignment. Exact start date will be communicated with enough time for you to plan effectively. Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary for this position is $65,000\.00 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Why Choose Us? Cognizant delivers solutions that draw upon the full power and scale of our associates. You will be supported by high\-caliber experts and employ some of the most advanced and patented capabilities. Our associate’s diverse backgrounds offer multifaceted perspectives and fuel new ways of thinking. We encourage lively discussions which inspire better results for our clients. Benefits Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off 401(k) plan and contributions Long\-term/Short\-term Disability Paid Parental Leave Employee Stock Purchase Plan Disclaimer The hourly rate, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law. Work Authorization Due to the nature of this position, Cognizant cannot provide sponsorship for U.S. work authorization (including participation in a CPT/OPT program) for this role. Cognizant is always looking for top talent. We are searching for candidates to fill future needs within the business. This job posting represents potential future employment opportunities with Cognizant. Although the position is not currently available, we want to provide you with the opportunity to express your interest in future employment opportunities with Cognizant. If a job opportunity that you may be qualified for becomes available in the future, we will notify you. At that time you can determine whether you would like to apply for the specific open position. Thank you for your interest in Cognizant career opportunities.
