jobs.title: Project Manager – Data Modernization
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Cyberlocke, we design solutions for our clients’ most complex technology and data challenges. The Business Analyst will play a key role in supporting our Data Modernization clients by translating business needs into actionable data requirements, facilitating stakeholder discovery, improving data quality and governance, and helping guide the transformation of legacy and fragmented data environments into modern, scalable, analytics\-ready platforms. Our Values * Continuous Learning / Never Satisfied * Does the right thing (even when no one is watching) * Get things done / Reliable * Humble / Confident, with a "One Company" mindset * Helpful/Positive/Can\-do attitude We live our values with each other and with our customers. Our values guide us for how we hire, perform, and reward at Cyberlocke. This is an onsite position to start and will transfer to a hybrid position after 90 days. **Position Summary** Cyberlocke is seeking a **Business Analyst – Data Modernization** to support the planning, discovery, design, implementation, and adoption of enterprise data modernization initiatives. The Business Analyst serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and Cyberlocke's technical delivery teams, translating business objectives, operational processes, reporting requirements, data challenges, and compliance needs into clearly defined requirements that can be implemented by data architects, data engineers, analytics developers, governance specialists, cloud engineers, and other technical resources. This role is especially important during customer discovery and throughout implementation. The Business Analyst will help clients understand their current data environment, identify business and data requirements, document the desired future state, prioritize use cases, define acceptance criteria, facilitate stakeholder decisions, and ensure delivered solutions address measurable business outcomes. Cyberlocke's Data Modernization practice includes services involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, data integration and transformation, analytics and Power BI, data governance, data quality, cloud data platforms, AI readiness, security and compliance, and ongoing managed data operations. The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis capabilities with an understanding of modern data platforms, analytics, governance, and cloud technologies. **Key Responsibilities** **Business Discovery and Requirements Analysis** * Lead and facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements\-gathering meetings with client business and technical teams. * Develop a clear understanding of the client's business objectives, operational processes, data environment, reporting requirements, pain points, risks, and modernization goals. * Translate business needs into clear functional, data, analytics, reporting, governance, security, and operational requirements. * Identify and document business problems that can be addressed through improved data integration, automation, analytics, governance, or modernization. * Define business use cases and expected outcomes for modernization initiatives. * Identify stakeholder priorities and reconcile conflicting requirements between departments or business units. * Help customers distinguish between business requirements, technical requirements, and future\-state opportunities. * Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle. **Current\-State Assessment** * Assist with assessments of the client's current data ecosystem, including applications, data sources, databases, spreadsheets, reporting platforms, integrations, processes, and business workflows. * Document how information currently moves through the organization. * Identify manual processes, duplicate data entry, reporting inefficiencies, data silos, inconsistent business definitions, data ownership issues, and other operational challenges. * Assist technical teams in identifying source systems and understanding the business context of data contained within those systems. * Develop current\-state process flows, data\-flow documentation, business process maps, and stakeholder maps. * Help identify reporting and analytics dependencies that may be affected by modernization efforts. **Future\-State Data Modernization Planning** * Work with Cyberlocke solution architects and technical teams to translate business requirements into future\-state solution requirements. * Help define the customer's desired future\-state data operating model. * Participate in development of modernization roadmaps, implementation priorities, and phased delivery plans. * Assist customers in prioritizing data sources, reporting requirements, business domains, use cases, and analytics capabilities. * Support development of data modernization strategies involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, cloud data platforms, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI readiness. * Help define success criteria an ation. * Assist Project Managers in defining scope, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, and deliverables. * Identify scope changes and requirements that may impact project timelines, resources, or costs. * Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, project status meetings, and other Agile or project\-delivery activities as required. * Maintain requirements and business documentation throughout the project lifecycle. * Support transition from project implementation into operational or managed\-service support when applicable. **Customer Adoption and Change Management** * Identify business processes affected by the modernization initiative. * Help customers understand how new data capabilities will change existing workflows. * Assist in development of user documentation and training requirements. * Support stakeholder communication and adoption activities. * Help identify organizational barriers to adoption and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. * Assist customers with transitioning from legacy reporting and manual processes to new enterprise data and analytics capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or similar role. * Experience gathering and documenting business and technical requirements. * Demonstrated ability to facilitate discovery sessions and stakeholder workshops. * Experience documenting business processes, functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience working with technical implementation teams. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical requirements. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong documentation and organizational skills. * Experience working with structured data, reporting, analytics, or business intelligence solutions. * Understanding of data integration, data quality, analytics, and data governance concepts. * Experience working with executive, business, and technical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple requirements, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting data modernization, cloud migration, data warehouse, data lake, analytics, or digital\-transformation initiatives. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric. * Experience with Power BI. * Experience with Microsoft Azure data services. * Familiarity with OneLake, Lakehouse, data warehouse, Medallion architecture, and modern data\-platform concepts. * Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or other data\-governance technologies. * Understanding of ETL/ELT and data\-integration processes. * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL concepts. * Experience developing data dictionaries, business glossaries, or source\-to\-target mappings. * Experience with Agile/Scrum project delivery. * Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, or similar collaboration and project\-management platforms. * Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing technology environments. * Experience supporting enterprise organizations or public\-sector customers. * Familiarity with AI, machine learning, generative AI, and AI\-readiness concepts. **About Cyberlocke** Cyberlocke helps organizations modernize their technology and data environments so they can operate more efficiently, improve decision making, strengthen governance, and prepare for emerging AI capabilities. Our Data Modernization practice helps organizations transform fragmented data environments into governed, scalable, analytics\-ready platforms through cloud data architecture, integration, Microsoft Fabric, analytics, governance, security, AI readiness, and ongoing data\-platform operations.

jobs.title: Hotel Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Maintenance / Rooms Engineer **Property:** Margaritaville Hotel Nashville **Department:** Engineering \& Facilities **Reports To:** Chief Engineer / Engineering Manager ### **SUMMARY** At Margaritaville Hotel Nashville, our Maintenance Engineers keep the paradise state of mind alive by ensuring our guest rooms, public spaces, roof deck pool, and food \& beverage outlets remain in top\-tier condition. The Rooms/Maintenance Engineer performs general maintenance, preventive care, and quick\-response repairs to equipment, fixtures, and hotel structures. Duties involve light electrical, plumbing, HVAC maintenance, carpentry, drywall, paint, vinyl repairs, and maintaining the relaxed, high\-quality, island\-inspired environment our guests expect in downtown Music City. ### **QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS** * **Communication:** Read, write, speak, and understand English fluently with strong interpersonal skills to interact warmly with guests, team members, and management. * **Experience:** 2–5 years of maintenance experience preferred in a full\-service hospitality, commercial, or institutional environment. * **Technical Skills:** Basic to intermediate skills in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical troubleshooting. * **Finishing Skills:** Experience with light carpentry, painting, vinyl/wall\-covering repair, and dry\-wall patching. * **Certifications:** CPO (Certified Pool Operator) certification strongly preferred (or willingness to obtain upon hire to service our outdoor pool deck). * **Flexibility \& Mobility:** Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends, evenings, and holidays, as dictated by hotel occupancy and event schedules. * **Licensing:** Valid driver’s license preferred. * **Safety:** Deep commitment to workplace safety regulations and health standards, ensuring zero threat to self, staff, or guests. ### **PERFORMANCE STANDARDS \& CORE VALUES** * **Island\-Class Guest Service:** Embody the Margaritaville "no worries" hospitality culture. Deliver prompt, courteous service to guests and internal departments with a focus on resolving issues quickly to exceed guest expectations. * **Work Habits \& Professionalism:** Maintain hotel standards for uniform, grooming, punctuality, and attendance. Demonstrate team\-first attitude and take ownership of daily work assignments. * **Personal Development \& Initiative:** Proactively expand technical skills, participate in cross\-training across facilities functions, and seek answers when encountering complex equipment repairs. * **Safety, Security \& Life Safety:** Actively participate in hazard identification, report security risks immediately, and adhere strictly to all emergency procedures, OSHA guidelines, and fire/life safety standards. * **Preventive Maintenance (PM):** Rigorously execute guest room PM schedules, keep supply carts stocked and organized, and ensure long\-term preservation of property assets. ### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Guest Room Maintenance:** Perform daily work orders and preventive maintenance (PM) in guest rooms and suites, including troubleshooting TV/Wi\-Fi/HVAC units, fixing plumbing fixtures, changing light bulbs, and repairing furniture or hardware. * **Public Space \& Venue Care:** Maintain and repair finishes, lighting, wall coverings, flooring, and fixtures throughout public areas, lobby, meeting spaces, and outdoor recreation areas (including the Fins Rooftop Pool \& Bar area). * **Food \& Beverage Operations Support:** Assist with routine maintenance and repairs for kitchen, bar, and laundry equipment; perform enzyme treatment and cleanings for F\&B floor drains weekly. * **Life Safety \& Systems Monitoring:** Monitor fire alarms, life safety systems, energy management systems, and building automation, responding promptly to system alerts. * **Pool \& Water Features:** Conduct routine water chemical testing, skimming, and basic equipment maintenance for pool systems in compliance with health department codes (CPO required/preferred). * **Work Order Management:** Utilize the hotel’s work\-order platform to track, update, and complete work requests in a timely, efficient manner. * **Inventory \& Tools:** Maintain clean, secure, and well\-organized shop environments, tool kits, and mobile supply carts. Report low inventory or component needs to engineering leadership promptly. * **General Facilities Support:** Assist with minor lock/key issues, signage installation, water heater changeouts, electrical cart maintenance, and general building repairs as assigned by leadership. * Attend all mandatory property and department meetings and safety trainings.

This role combines strong software engineering expertise with hands\-on experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling the development of robust systems that support intelligent workflows, data processing, model integration, automation, and AI\-assisted decision making. jobs.description: **Senior Onsite Field Manager – Data Center** The Senior Onsite Field Manager oversees a team of On\-Site Service Engineers (OSEs) to ensure operational excellence in Data Center environments. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Product Data
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineer – Product Data** Job Summary ECS designs and builds engineered\-to\-order air pollution control and odor control systems \- FRP scrubbers, carbon adsorbers, fans, and ductwork \- for municipal and industrial clients. No two jobs are identical. This role turns engineering drawings and 3D models into the manufacturing bill of material that the shop actually builds from. You read the drawing, understand how the equipment goes together, decide what is purchased versus fabricated versus assembled, and structure the BOM so purchasing buys the right parts and the shop builds in the right sequence. You sit between Engineering and Operations — in SolidWorks PDM, on the shop floor, and in front of fabricators and purchasing every day. **Two things this job is not: it is not a business intelligence or reporting position — there is no SQL, Power BI, or dashboard work; and it is not a process, tooling, or automation engineering position. The product data is the product here.** What You Will Do · Read and interpret engineering drawings, weldment and assembly models, and specifications to determine how each piece of equipment is built. · Build the manufacturing BOM and product structure for each job — breaking the design into purchased, fabricated, and assembled content that matches how the shop actually works. · Work directly with Design Engineering to resolve drawing gaps, missing part data, and structures that cannot be built as drawn — before they reach the floor. · Maintain part data and metadata in SolidWorks PDM: part numbers, descriptions, materials, and revision states. · Process Engineering Change Orders and implement BOM revisions on schedule, using PDM where\-used to identify every affected assembly and open job. · Standardize product structures across similar equipment to drive reuse, shorten engineering cycles, and reduce shop variation. · Enforce ECS part numbering, naming, and revision conventions across all systems. · Own BOM accuracy: audit released BOMs on a set cadence, drive root cause on recurring errors, and close the loop with the engineer or process that caused them. · Serve as the single point of contact for BOM and product structure questions across Engineering, Purchasing, Production, and Supply Chain. · Support lean and continuous improvement work through BOM, routing, and kitting improvements. Required Qualifications · Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, engineering technology — or equivalent hands\-on experience in a fabrication or custom manufacturing environment. · 2–5 years in manufacturing engineering, product engineering, production engineering, or a BOM / product structure role. Build\-to\-order or custom equipment experience preferred. · Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, weldments, assemblies, and specifications without hand\-holding. · Hands\-on SolidWorks experience. Working knowledge of a PDM or PLM system — check\-in/check\-out, data cards and metadata, revision states, and where\-used queries. SolidWorks PDM preferred; we will train the right engineer on our vault. · Direct experience creating, structuring, or restructuring manufacturing BOMs — not only maintaining item master records handed to you. · Strong Excel skills. Smartsheet experience is a plus; ECS uses Smartsheet as the system of record for production BOM data. · Willing to spend time on the shop floor. This role is on\-site in Belton, Texas. Preferred Qualifications · Engineer\-to\-order or custom equipment manufacturing background. · FRP, thermoplastics, sheet metal, or structural weldment fabrication experience. · Familiarity with GD\&T, welding symbols, and fabrication drawing standards. · ERP item master, routing, and MRP exposure. · Formal engineering change management (ECO/ECN) process experience. What Success Looks Like · BOM accuracy at release — errors per BOM. · ECO implementation cycle time. · BOM\-driven production errors, rework, and expedite purchases. · On\-time BOM completion against engineering release dates. · Growth in standardized, reusable product structures across the product lines. Who This Role Is For The right person is an engineer who is happier resolving how a air pollutions control scrubber actually gets built than producing a report about it. You should be comfortable telling a designer their drawing will not work on the floor, and comfortable being the person everyone calls when a BOM is wrong. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of experience do you have creating or maintaining manufacturing Bills of Materials? * Can you read and interpret mechanical engineering drawings independently, including part callouts and revision blocks? * How many years have you worked hands\-on in SolidWorks PDM — checking files in and out, updating data cards and metadata, and managing revision states? Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Pflugerville, TX, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; Red Oak, TX, USA; Houston, TX, USA; Pryor Creek, OK, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures (including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems) and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. In this role, you will help make interacting with Google Search as natural as talking to a human. By fusing Gemini audio intelligence with consumer design, you will help users turn thoughts into interactive conversations and navigate Google Search.In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role. * 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc). * 3 years managing and developing consumer\-facing mobile or AI\-driven UX products. * Experience leading Product Management (PM) teams (e.g., people management). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 7 years of experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders. * 5 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership. * Experience building products that are focused on consumer behavior, audio design, and conversational user interfaces. * Experience balancing consumer reach with infrastructure constraints (e.g., cost, latency, and model optimization). * Familiarity with modern machine learning, audio models (ASR, text\-to\-speech), LLMs, and foundational models (such as Gemini). **About the job** ----------------- At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. In this role, you will help make interacting with Google Search as natural as talking to a human. By fusing Gemini audio intelligence with consumer design, you will help users turn thoughts into interactive conversations and navigate Google Search.In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $240000 \- $333000 (USD) \+ 25% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the end\-to\-end product goal, streamlining and integration of Search microphones and Search Live into a cohesive, simplified consumer experience within main Search. * Evolve the Voice Search stack away from legacy auto\-endpointing to support natural, long\-form queries, multimodal inputs, and advanced multilingual capabilities powered by Gemini models. * Scale Search Live to deliver deep, natural, proactive voice conversations and educational use cases backed by on\-screen visuals. * Partner closely with Gemini research and engineering teams to translate cutting\-edge AI breakthroughs into production\-grade consumer features while balancing scale, cost, and latency. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Data Center Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: This role will require you to be on site 5 days a week. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Ridgeville, SC, USA; Saint George, SC, USA; Summerville, SC, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in design, construction, and commissioning of either chilled water cooling systems, air handling systems, fire suppression systems, plumbing systems, or underground dry/wet utilities. * 5 years of experience with electro/mechanical assembly and mechanical testing procedures including resolution and comprehensive documentation maintenance for mechanical designs. * 5 years of experience in mission critical facility design, construction environments, and their mechanical infrastructure. * 5 years of experience with data center operations and working with mechanical contractors and cross\-functional project teams. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or other relevant fields, or a Professional Engineering (PE) license. * Experience in designing modular building scale assemblies, with an understanding of mechanical tolerances and tolerance analysis. * Knowledge of mechanical engineering and design principles with a focus in the areas of design for medium\-scale production, structural beams/elements, and international building codes. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). As a Data Center Services Mechanical Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the field\-level implementation and operational support of Google’s rapidly expanding data centers. You will be responsible for overseeing the design, construction, and commissioning of HVAC and mechanical distribution systems, ensuring projects are delivered safely, swiftly, and with high quality. This involves managing site\-level mechanical engineering issues, ensuring compliance with design standards and local regulations, supporting quality assurance, and providing technical guidance to vendor teams. You will be a strong communicator and collaborator who will grow on construction sites and has experience with mechanical systems, ideally within mission\-critical facilities, heavy industrial, oil and gas, or semiconductor industries. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide technical support to data center services and operations teams, defining mechanical system design requirements for multiple data center projects from inception to completion. * Collaborate with DCDE core teams to develop, implement, and manage the data center (DC) mechanical designs at site starting from basis of design (BOD) to issued for construction (IFC) data center services documents for new DC projects build outs, infrastructure upgrades, and renovations. * Respond to site specific engineering requests for information (RFI) in coordination with engineer of record (EOR). Manage site bug process and coordinate with DCDE cross functional teams for technical support. * Participate in new technology insertions through collaboration with the engineering team to provide site specific requirements during the development of site specific BOD. * Own and manage all site level mechanical system issues during the project execution phase. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Product Design Engineer, Platforms
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering and design principles, including production, sheet metal, castings, injection molding, structural analysis, and design of cooling solutions. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience developing products with high speed signal, power, and cooling interconnects. * Experience in the mechanical design and engineering of high density, high component count Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) assemblies. * Experience in designing electro\-mechanical assemblies with an understanding of mechanical tolerances from chip to data center scale, tolerance stackup analysis, quick connect/disconnect technologies and mechanisms. * Experience in designing thermal solutions for high power ASICS and knowledge of advanced cooling technologies. **About the job** ----------------- Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting\-edge custom hardware designed and made in\-house. Our Mechanical Product Design Engineering Team members work cross\-functionally to design, build, and deploy the latest technology to support the needs of compute, storage, networking, and machine learning hardware. As a Senior Mechanical Product Design Engineer, you design and evaluate the data center systems, identify product requirements, and contribute to research and project planning. From the chip to chiller, you are responsible for designing and optimizing products within the architecture that will change and scale with Google's continued growth. With your technical expertise, you lead and manage engineering design decisions, perform detailed design and analysis, develop product and process improvements, and collaborate with cross\-functional team members to build innovative solutions. Behind everything the users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining the data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We are always on call to keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own and design products over the entire product design life cycle including requirements gathering, concept generation, detailed design with analysis, cross\-functional reviews, verification testing, manufacturing release, and sustaining. * Ensure designs are fundamentally sound, scalable, robust, and meet engineering requirements backed by thorough engineering analysis and product validation through developing test plans, performing testing ensuring designs. Troubleshoot, root cause, and resolve technical challenges that arise throughout the product development life\-cycle. * Influence and shape future products by providing mechanical and product design engineering expertise into the technology roadmap with data\-driven decisions. * Identify and scope projects around innovation opportunities as well as technology risks. * Provide engineering knowledge and mentor team members in areas of expertise. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Jose, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience programming in Python or C\+\+. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * 3 years of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience developing accessible technologies. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Write and test product or system development code. * Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency,) * Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback. * Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality. * Design and implement solutions in one or more specialized ML areas, leverage ML infrastructure, and demonstrate expertise in a chosen field. jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled Chief Engineer to lead our facilities and maintenance operations. This pivotal role involves overseeing the entire engineering department, ensuring the seamless functioning of manufacturing and industrial systems, and maintaining a safe, efficient, and compliant environment. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional management capabilities, technical expertise in electrical and mechanical systems, and a proactive approach to facilities management. As Chief Engineer, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives, supervise maintenance teams, and coordinate complex projects to support our operational excellence. **Duties** * Lead and manage all aspects of facilities maintenance, including HVAC systems, electrical infrastructure (high and low voltage), mechanical equipment, and industrial machinery. * Oversee the development and implementation of maintenance management strategies utilizing CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) tools to optimize asset performance. * Supervise maintenance teams, providing leadership, training, and guidance to ensure safety standards and operational efficiency are maintained at all times. * Review schematics, technical drawings, and electrical/mechanical diagrams to troubleshoot issues effectively and plan repairs or upgrades. * Manage projects related to facilities upgrades, equipment installation, or process improvements with a focus on safety, quality, and timeline adherence. * Ensure compliance with safety regulations related to high voltage, low voltage systems, and industrial maintenance procedures. * Utilize tools such as ohmmeters for electrical testing and diagnostics to identify faults accurately. * Coordinate with cross\-functional teams in manufacturing environments to minimize downtime and maximize productivity. * Maintain detailed records of maintenance activities, inspections, repairs, and system modifications using CMMS software. * Foster a culture of safety awareness and continuous improvement within the engineering team. **Qualifications** * Proven management experience in facilities or industrial maintenance leadership roles. * Extensive knowledge of HVAC systems, electrical systems (including high voltage and low voltage), mechanical systems, schematics, and industrial equipment. * Strong background in maintenance management practices within manufacturing or industrial settings. * Hands\-on experience with programmable logic controllers (PLCs) used in automation processes. * Familiarity with CMMS platforms for work order tracking and asset management. * Demonstrated supervisory skills with the ability to lead diverse teams effectively. * Excellent project management skills with a focus on safety compliance and quality standards. * Proficiency in reading technical schematics and electrical diagrams; experience with ohmmeters essential. * Fluency in English required for effective communication across teams; additional languages are a plus. * Knowledge of facilities management best practices including HVAC system operation, electrical safety protocols, and industrial maintenance procedures. Join us as our Chief Engineer to shape the future of our operations through innovative leadership and technical excellence! Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= The Senior Solutions Architect works with user groups to solve business problems with available technology including hardware, software, databases, and peripherals. The Senior Solutions Architect work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Senior Solutions Architect translates business needs into technical systems solutions. Integrates hardware, software and network interfaces to form a system. Begins to influence department’s strategy. Makes decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Lead Engineer, or Senior Developer delivering enterprise\-scale digital solutions. * Proven experience designing and implementing large\-scale digital platforms and customer\-facing applications. * Strong expertise in cloud\-native architecture and Azure cloud services. * Experience with API\-first design, microservices architecture, and modern integration patterns. * Strong understanding of modern front\-end architectures, including micro\-frontend concepts and responsive application design. * Experience leading cross\-functional teams and driving architectural decisions across multiple projects. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience with Adobe Experience Platform * Experience leading digital transformation initiatives within large enterprises. * Expertise in digital experience platforms (DXP), content management systems (CMS), customer engagement platforms, or personalization solutions. * Experience with customer journey orchestration, omnichannel engagement, and digital product development. * Knowledge of modern DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, and platform engineering practices. * Experience with accessibility standards, performance optimization, and user experience best practices. * Prior experience as a project architect, technical lead, or architecture practice leader. * Strong passion for delivering exceptional customer and employee digital experiences. Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $117,600 \- $161,700 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com. **Equal Opportunity Employer** It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Husky TechnologiesTM United States manufacturing facility is located in Milton, Vermont on a large, beautiful campus located just 30 minutes north of downtown Burlington, Vermont. Features include an onsite cafeteria, open office concept, fitness center, intramural sports activities and clean, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment, competitive total compensation and attractive benefits package. Additional things you might like to know about working at Husky TechnologiesTM in Milton, Vermont; * 200,000 square foot bright, clean machine shop * Shift work premiums (25% afternoon shift and 40% evening shift) * Annual incentive bonus * Outstanding 401k contribution and match program * 700 acres of private land to walk, bike, run or cross country ski * On site gym facility * On site cafeteria * Opportunity to work for a world class company with great people Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Range: $125,000\-$155,000 Vacancy: ADD Are you interested in developing new products and technologies? Have experience defining and developing tooling for the packaging market? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic learning environment? Are you interested in joining a team of innovative engineers working for the leading global supplier of injection molding equipment for the plastic industry? If you answered yes, this role is for you. Our Development Engineering team is looking to hire an experienced Product Development Engineer. The successful candidate will lead the technical development of packaging products working with business development, completing engineering, and subsequent launch into our manufacturing operations. **Role Description:** * System level design with limited guidance, frequently in the absence of specific design standards. * Product Architect * Participate in the formulation and/or evaluation of business cases. * Work within a team of Engineers/Design Specialists in the development of new Injection Molding tooling products following appropriate steps within a formal product development process. * Guide and approve the content of design documents and validation plans. * Contribute to, verify and monitor engineering documentation. * Apply scientific/engineering principles design execution. * Sizing and selection of components (for example, but not limited to linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Provide leadership, mentoring and training to team members. * Create system level concept designs in various levels of detail including function block diagrams, CAD layouts, functional decomposition. * Lead and contribute to design reviews and brainstorming sessions. Responsible for decision making in the context of product definition and architecture. * Participate in or lead continuous improvement activities. * Verify all concept and systems level process steps of the product development process and Product Release process are followed. * Drives the product development process levering team collaboration. * Design risk mitigation including participation or facilitation of FMEA. * Champion of product compliance with regulatory requirements. * Cross discipline interaction and communication including cross discipline inputs – Business Development, Analysis, Electrical, Software, Fluid Power, Metallurgy, Manufacturing, Validation/Test. * Represent Husky technically in front of customers, suppliers and technical partners. * Represent the Innovation and Sustainability department in front of internal customers including the executive. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering **Qualifications and Skills:** * 10 \+ years of design experience in a relevant industry. * Excellent communication (verbal and written) and strong presentation skills. * Specialized knowledge of products, tools, standards, processes and technology. * Specialized knowledge within injection molding, tooling and or plastics processing market. * Skilled in CAD modeling techniques – Unigraphics preferred. * Expert in calculating design parameters and applying engineering principles to design. * Strong time management and organizational skills for maximum efficiency. * Illustrates attention to detail when completing tasks. * Strong problem\-solving skills. * Advanced creativity and innovation skills. * Strong sense of ownership. * Advanced understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes related to injection molding tooling. * A flexible team player. * Demonstrated ability to lead and work both autonomously, and as part of a highly cohesive cross functional team. * Experience selecting appropriate materials and sizing various components. (for example, but not limited to, linear motors, sensors, bearings, gearboxes, belts, seals, servo motors, pneumatic and hydraulic components, etc.) as well as material selection and application of design standards. * Well\-rounded – hands\-on mechanical ability and passion for interests and hobbies outside of work. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please. If you need special assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at talent@husky.ca. Equal Opportunity Employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c).

jobs.title: iOS Team Lead - Onsite - Dallas
jobs.description: **Lab49** is an award\-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the world's leading financial institutions. Founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley engineering practices to Wall Street, we have delivered hundreds of high\-impact projects across global investment banks and buy\-side firms, spanning distributed systems, high\-performance automation, enterprise UX, cloud, and data\-driven platforms. At **Lab49,** engineers work directly with clients to design and deliver production systems. We combine technology, design, and business expertise to solve real problems where quality, performance, and clarity matter. **LAB49** is currently looking for an iOS Team Lead who will play a critical role on key projects for Lab49 clients. Working in a collaborative and innovative project team, with direct client\-facing interactions, you will have an opportunity to apply your skills and expertise to design innovative applications that solve complex problems and enhance performance and productivity at our marquis clients. In particular, you will help build and modernize large\-scale consumer banking experiences, focusing on areas such as customer onboarding, account management, and money movement. As part of a greenfield initiative, you will lead the development of new mobile capabilities designed to support expansion into new markets and evolving regulatory requirements. ### **THE ROLE** As an iOS Team Lead, you are a true project leader. You own the technical direction and delivery of client engagements while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around you. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will design systems, write code when it matters most, guide architectural decisions, and ensure the team delivers high\-quality outcomes even when you are not directly contributing code. You will work closely with client stakeholders, designers, product partners, and Lab49 leadership to ensure solutions are technically sound, aligned with business objectives, and delivered with excellence. This is an on\-site role – 5 days/ week in Richardson, TX ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Design, implement, deliver, and test innovative iOS Swift applications while understanding our products from both a technical and product perspective in the context of our client’s business. * Communicate with leadership, product owners, other technologists and users to create working software based on an understanding of business and technical priorities. * Break down complex problems into elegant technical solutions to intelligently solve problems for Lab49's clients. * Actively contribute to the adoption of strong software architecture, development best practices and new technologies. We are always improving the process of building software; we’ll need your help to do that. * Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends. * Experiment with and learn new technologies. ### **What Success Looks Like** * Your teams consistently deliver high\-quality software that meets user and client objectives. * Engineers around you become more autonomous, capable, and effective because of your leadership. * Clients trust your judgment and rely on you for technical direction and clarity. * You demonstrate strong ownership of outcomes, proactively addressing risks before they become issues. * You can step away from day\-to\-day coding when needed without compromising delivery quality or team performance. ### **What You Should Have** * 10\-12\+ years of experience designing and building complex, commercial\-grade software systems, with 4\+ years leading Agile teams * Proficiency in Swift and experience with native iOS development tools such as SwiftUI, and UIKit * Experience in consumer banking including account management and onboarding. * Familiarity with integrating RESTful APIs and third\-party libraries * Experience with agile development methodologies * Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for mobile applications * Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and best practices to create intuitive and engaging user experiences * Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience in fraud management/KYC/AML and regulatory reporting * Experience using on device biometrics for authentication * A strong portfolio of released applications on the App Store * Experience with AppConfig community standards and enterprise app distribution * College degree in Computer Science or related field of study or equivalent experience * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Copilot) to improve team velocity and code quality, and help the team adopt them responsibly ### **Why Lab49?** At Lab49, you'll work on complex, meaningful challenges alongside talented engineers, designers, and consultants. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies, business domains, and client environments while continuing to grow your career. We value curiosity, judgment, and ownership. If you care about quality, enjoy helping others succeed, and want your work to have a meaningful impact, Lab49 is a place where you can thrive. **Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.** **Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: The 30\-second version LeadrPro is a B2B marketplace where software sellers meet verified, paid buyers. Our AI agent, LP, now lives inside our customers' Slack workspaces — surfacing matched buyers, drafting outreach, triaging demo requests, and pushing meeting prep into the channels where their teams already work. Every customer's Slack agent is only as good as the prompts behind it. Right now, a human has to sit with each account, learn their ICP, their voice, and their sales motion, and tune the agent until it earns its place in the channel. **That human is you.** You'll be embedded with real revenue teams, writing and testing the prompts that make their agents useful — then turning what works into templates so the next 100 customers get it in an hour instead of a week. This is not a research role. You will talk to customers. You will ship on day three. What you'll actually do **Onboard customer agents.** Run configuration sessions with new accounts, extract their ICP, tone, product positioning, and edge cases, and translate all of it into working system prompts and tool configurations for their Slack agent. **Write, break, and fix prompts.** Draft prompts, build small eval sets from real customer scenarios, run them, find where the agent hallucinates, over\-hedges, or sounds like a robot, and fix it. Version everything. Document why each change worked. **Own the feedback loop.** Read agent transcripts. Find the recurring failure modes across accounts. Bring the top three to the product team every Friday with a proposed fix, not just a complaint. **Turn one\-offs into product.** The job is to make yourself unnecessary. Every bespoke prompt you write should end up as a reusable template, a variable, or an onboarding question. We measure you on how much of your work stops being manual. **Be the customer's person.** When an account says "the agent isn't getting it," you're the one who responds, diagnoses, and closes the loop — usually the same day. What good looks like **Day 30** — You've onboarded 5\+ customer agents end to end without a hand on your shoulder. You've built our first shared eval set. **Day 60** — Median time\-to\-first\-value for a new Slack agent is under 24 hours, down from where we started. You've published a prompt library the rest of the team uses. **Day 90** — At least 60% of new agent configurations are handled by templates you built, not by a person. You've shipped at least one prompt change that measurably lifted a customer metric — reply rate, meetings booked, or agent messages actually acted on. Who this is for * You've built something real with an LLM API — a side project, a tool, an automation. Not a certificate. A thing that ran. * You write clearly. Prompt engineering is 80% writing, and vague writers produce vague agents. * You can read and edit JSON, understand what a tool call is, and debug why one failed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can't be afraid of a terminal. * You're comfortable on a Zoom with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of AI and short on time. * You're allergic to leaving a problem half\-diagnosed. Who this isn't for * Anyone who wants to "explore AI strategy." We need output, not frameworks. * Anyone who needs a spec before starting. You'll get a customer, a goal, and a deadline. * Anyone who would rather not talk to customers. Half this job is listening. Bonus points Experience with Slack's API or bot framework · evals or LLM observability tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, or homegrown) · B2B SaaS or sales ops background · you've worked a quota\-carrying or SDR seat and know why sellers ignore tools Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

track through rapid closure. * Scope, plan, and direct technical work across product, process, tooling, and materials for design/development activities. * Analyze complex design problems using engineering and mathematical methods; jobs.title: Senior Mechatronics Technician
jobs.description: **Location:** Gonzales / Salinas Valley, California **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Salary:** $95,000\-$115,000 per year **About Mantis** Mantis Ag Technology is an innovative agricultural technology company focused on developing advanced automation and precision material application services to improve efficiency, sustainability, and productivity in modern farming. Based in Gonzales, CA, we work at the intersection of agriculture and cutting\-edge engineering to bring practical, scalable solutions to growers. **Position Overview** We are hiring an experienced mechatronics technician to help prototype, build, troubleshoot, and maintain equipment used in California and Arizona. This is a senior, hands\-on role for someone with strong mechanical and electrical systems and troubleshooting skills who can also work through computer and software issues, share knowledge among teammates, and help improve how our service work is organized and documented. **What You Will Do** * Diagnose mechanical, electronic, and basic software problems on machines in the shop and in the field to restore equipment to service quickly and safely. * Assemble, wire, test, repair, and commission machines, subassemblies, harnesses, sensors, cameras, controls, and related field equipment. * Work alongside the engineering team on development efforts, helping to design, build, and modify test platforms in the shop and field. * Use schematics, instruments, service information, and a systematic troubleshooting process to isolate root causes rather than swapping parts without a diagnosis. * Spearhead difficult troubleshooting efforts and work with engineers and technicians to reproduce failures, test prototypes and design changes, and document results from the shop and field. * Support customers and field personnel in person and remotely, communicating clearly about symptoms, priorities, next steps, and repair status. * Improve service records, standard operating procedures, parts usage, and inventory information using Microsoft Office tools. * Travel independently to customer sites in California and Arizona and represent Mantis professionally in active agricultural environments. The seasonal nature of fresh vegetable production means you may spend up to a month in the Yuma and Imperial Valley areas during the winter. **What We Are Looking For** * 7\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience with industrial, automotive, agricultural, or other complex electromechanical equipment. An associates degree or equivalent certification in mechatronics, electrical, mechanical, industrial, automotive, or agricultural technology is helpful but not required. * Strong mechanical aptitude and experience troubleshooting automotive electrical systems, wiring, connectors, sensors, motors, or controls. Heavy\-equipment or off\-highway machinery experience is especially useful. * Comfort with shop tools, fabrication, welding, machining, and hydraulics is required. Experience with CAN bus, embedded computer systems, or agricultural equipment is strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of Windows computers and Microsoft Office, plus enough software and networking familiarity to gather logs, follow procedures, and help distinguish a hardware problem from a software problem. * Sound judgment, organized work habits, clear written and verbal communication, and a record of taking ownership while keeping others informed. * The ability and interest to share knowledge, coordinate work, improve processes, and take on responsibility when required. * A valid driver's license, the ability to lift up to 55 pounds, and willingness to work outdoors around farm machinery and travel as field activity requires. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual salary range is $95,000 to $115,000, with eligibility for a performance\-based year\-end bonus. The starting offer will reflect relevant experience, technical breadth, and the scope at which the candidate can operate. Housing and per\-diem are provided when traveling. Mantis offers a **company vehicle**, PTO, health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with matched contributions, and opportunities to grow with a small cross\-functional team. **How to Apply** Email a resume and a short note describing relevant professional experience to **jobs@mantisag\-tech.com**. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US. *Mantis Ag Technology is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.* Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

**What You'll Do** * Serve as a key engineer for order management and warehouse technology platforms supporting high\-volume distribution operations. * Support system integrations across order management, warehouse management, inventory control, finance, and other supply chain functions to improve operational efficiency and business continuity. * Develop and optimize complex Oracle stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, and SQL queries. * Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams to implement enhancements and system improvements. * Perform root cause analysis and deliver sustainable solutions for inventory variances, transaction failures, and data integrity issues across integrated systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve application, database, and system performance issues. * Participate in production "on call" rotation support activities, issue resolution, root cause analysis, and system monitoring. * Participate in software deployment, testing, QA, documentation and installation efforts. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field. * 4\+ years of experience developing applications using Oracle PL/SQL. * Experience developing complex SQL queries and optimizing database performance. * Experience with warehouse management, order management, inventory control, or related supply chain systems. * Experience with cross\-system integrations using technologies such as MQ, shell scripting, Kafka, or similar enterprise integration tools. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. * This position requires the ability to read, write, and understand English at a level sufficient to perform job\-related tasks effectively and safely. Our story.** We've been forging our path as a leader in the distribution industry since 1894\. Building an expansive nationwide network of team members for 130\+ years has allowed us to stay agile for our clients across the restaurant, retail, and e\-commerce industries. We look to the future and are ready to continue making industry\-defining moves by embracing the newest technology into our practices, continuing team member training, and emphasizing our people\-centered culture. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
